draft.subject: Northstar pilot readiness and the remaining uptime question
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Ahead of your deployment decision, I'd like to review the existing 1,200-user pilot against its original engagement, repeat-usage, and deployment-milestone goals. Those areas are mostly met, but the customer uptime feedback needs to be clarified before anyone can recommend a broader rollout.

Would you and Casey be open to a short pilot-readiness discussion with Priya and me? We can walk through the existing presentation, understand the reported uptime concern and its operational impact, and cover Casey's supporting audit and retention questions without assuming the expansion has been approved.

Best,
Riley Morgan

draft.subject: A governance update relevant to Harbor's engineering team
draft.body:
Hi Quinn,

I wanted to reconnect because last week we launched Meridian Governance Verified Controls, including stronger audit visibility, configurable retention, and more granular role-based controls. Those updates map closely to the engineering and governance questions your team raised during discovery.

If it would be useful, I can share a short walkthrough tailored to Harbor's internal knowledge workflows. Also, has your team confirmed who now owns the executive purchasing decision? I want to make sure we follow the right path and avoid duplicating anyone else's outreach.

Best,
Riley Morgan
